reason: A local-first Markdown knowledge-base plugin for SEO, GEO, and AEO auditing, content planning, provenance checks, and guarded content updates, with public URL analysis and manual submission preparation.

summaries.zh: 面向 Markdown 知识库提供本地优先的 SEO、GEO 和 AEO 审计、内容规划、来源检查及受版本保护的内容更新。
summaries.en: A local-first plugin for SEO, GEO, and AEO audits, content planning, provenance checks, and version-guarded updates to Markdown knowledge bases.

capabilities: Reads and analyzes local Markdown notes and knowledge bases
Fetches public URLs through an anonymous web fetch interface
Generates SEO, GEO, and AEO audits, content briefs, and production plans
Previews and applies version-guarded Markdown replacements within a configured root
Imports keyword data from CSV, JSON, and Markdown
Prepares manual backlink or product-discovery submission packs without mass posting
